description: Primary listing-discovery tool for homes in Singapore. Use this when the user asks what properties are available, or describes a home to buy or rent by area, MRT station, budget, bedrooms, flat type or other criteria. Omit query for a broad availability request; query is full-text search over project, title, address and description. pagination.total is the exact number of matching listings. Returns summaries of active, published Homejourney listings that may be shown in AI assistants: price, size, address, nearest MRT, nearby schools, a Homejourney link and a link to book a viewing, but never the owner or agent contact details.

available_from.description: The renter's move-in date. Matches homes available on or before it, and homes that state no date.

bathroom_counts.description: Exact bathroom counts to match; combines with bathrooms_min.

bedroom_counts.description: Exact bedroom counts to match, such as [2, 3]; 0 is a studio. Combines with bedrooms_min, so [0] plus bedrooms_min 5 means studio or 5+.

districts.description: Singapore postal districts, such as "D09" or "15".

furnishing.description: The furnishing the renter wants. Matches homes stated as this, and homes that state no furnishing.

hdb_flat_types.description: HDB flat types, such as "4-room" or "executive".

lease_duration_months.description: The renter's lease length in months. Matches homes whose minimum lease is at most this, and homes that state no minimum.

mrt_lines.description: MRT lines; a listing matches when its nearest station is on one. Combines with mrt_stations as 'near any'.

mrt_stations.description: Nearest MRT station names, such as "Orchard" or "Tanjong Pagar".

psf_max.description: Price per square foot in SGD.

psf_min.description: Price per square foot in SGD.

reachable_only.description: Only homes whose owner or agent can be reached now: a viewing request reaches the owner or a Homejourney agent, or the lister takes WhatsApp. Leaves out homes whose agent is not on Homejourney yet and has no verified WhatsApp number. pagination.total counts only these homes.

sort.description: newest is the recommended order; listed_newest is strictly by listing date.

towns.description: HDB towns, URA planning areas or URA regions the listing lies in, such as "Tampines", "Bukit Timah" or "East". A region (Central, East, North, North-East, West) covers all its planning areas.

name: search_listings

bookingUrl.description: Where the user asks for a viewing.

depositMonths.description: Details and compare, for an owner rental: the security deposit in months of rent, as the owner stated it. Null when not stated; partner listings carry none.

facing.description: Details only: which way the main windows face, as the owner states it (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W or NW).

floorplans.description: Details only: published floor plan image URLs.

hdbFlatType.description: Search results only, for an HDB flat: its flat type, such as 4-room or executive, inferred from its block's resale records and its size.

hdbLease.description: Details and compare, for an HDB flat: its block's lease start year, the lease left this month and the block's age in years, as in lease; kept for earlier clients. Null when unknown.

houseRules.description: Details and compare: the house rules the listing states, such as {"pets": false, "cooking": true} (true allowed, false not allowed) or rules in words such as ["no_smoking"]. Empty or null when it states none.

imageLabels.description: One per image, in order: the tag to show with an owner's edited photo, or null for an unedited one.

lease.description: Search, compare and details, for every home: its tenure, the lease left this month and its age from TOP, as the listing page shows them. An HDB flat's lease comes from its block's resale records; a condo, EC or landed home's from URA's records of its land lease, not its TOP. remainingLabel is 'Lease start not confirmed' for a leasehold whose start is not found, and null for freehold and 999-year homes. Null when nothing is known.

startYear.description: The year the lease began; null when not confirmed.

tenureLabel.description: Such as 99-year lease from 2000, or Freehold; null when the tenure is not known.

listedAt.description: When the listing was first shown publicly.

nearbyPlaces.description: Details only: the places the listing page shows near the block. mrtStations (code, name, walkMinutes), primarySchoolsWithin1Km and primarySchools1To2Km (the Primary 1 registration bands), secondarySchools, supermarkets, hawkerCentres (within 2 km) and clinics (CHAS clinics within 1 km, type gp or dental), the last three with name, place and walkMinutes, each with distanceKm. Distances are straight-line from the block and walks are estimates; for Primary 1 registration, the user checks the exact distance on OneMap SchoolQuery.

price.description: SGD; monthly rent for a rental.

priceReason.description: Details only: the owner's own words on why the home is priced as it is.

renovationYear.description: Details only: the year the owner last renovated.

seller.description: Details only, for an owner listing: whether the owner verified with Singpass, their weekly viewing hours (Singapore time, weekday 0 is Sunday; empty when none are open), and how many minutes they usually take to first answer a viewing request (null until they have answered at least 3).

storeyRange.description: Details only: HDB's three-storey band, such as 13 to 15, never the exact storey.

featured.description: Labelled Pro listings matching the search, on page 1 only.
